title: ThermoML Property INDIV Snapshot — Per-DOI Measurement Card Schema
description: Defines the structure for per-DOI measurement cards. One card per paper (DOI), containing ALL experimental blocks from that paper. Each block may contain 1–6 measured properties sharing the same compounds, variables, constraints, and data points. This is the actual data layer — what agents load when they need measured values. Follows the universal INDIV pattern: CCS sample → per-DOI, MTDKS methods → per-DOI, RMS → per-DOI, PCS data → per-DOI.
lineage: Evolved from _base_card_schema v1.0.0 (per-property, 1 card per property per block) → _block_card_schema v2.0.0 (per-block, 1 card per block) → PCS_property_INDIV_snapshot v3.0.0 (per-DOI, 1 card per paper, all blocks inside) → v4.0.0 (card-embedded block_search_adv identity permutations and uncapped statistics) → v5.0.0 (deterministic point IDs and composition-subsystem projections without duplicating parent blocks)

design_notes.why_per_doi: All other INDIV cards are per-DOI (CCS sample, MTDKS methods, RMS metadata). PCS follows the same pattern: one card per paper, containing all experimental blocks. This keeps the agent's lookup pattern uniform — given a DOI, load one card per schema type.
design_notes.blocks_inside_card: Each card contains a blocks[] array. Each block is a self-contained measurement unit with its own compounds, properties, variables, constraints, data_summary, and data_points. Blocks within a paper share the same DOI and paper metadata but have independent experimental setups.
design_notes.block_level_design: Within each block, the design preserves the ThermoML block as the natural unit of measurement. All properties in a block share the same compounds, variables, constraints, and data points.
design_notes.multi_property_blocks: 2.5% of blocks have 3–6 properties (always the same property group, never mixed). Each data point carries property values for ALL properties in the block. 97.5% have exactly 1 property.
design_notes.reaction_blocks: ReactionData blocks always have exactly 1 property. Reaction-specific fields (reaction_type, participants) only appear for block_type='ReactionData'.
design_notes.relationship_to_ID_and_DK: Each property in blocks[].properties[] references a PCS ID_and_DK card via prop_ID. Agents load the ID_and_DK card to understand WHAT the property is, then use this INDIV card for the actual VALUES.
design_notes.cross_references: Lightweight pointers to other card types: key.lit_num_id → RMS, blocks[].compounds[].comp_num_id → CCS, blocks[].properties[].meas_num_id → MTDKS, blocks[].properties[].prop_num_id → PCS ID_and_DK.
design_notes.derived_block_index: blocks_summary.derived_indexes contains block_search_adv plus composition_subsystems. The latter records exact-zero-supported unary/binary projections of higher-component PureOrMixtureData blocks and references existing point rows; it creates no additional card, parent block, or copied measurement.
design_notes.token_budget: The human-facing block_index remains small, but raw blocks_summary now also contains a potentially large machine-facing derived_indexes payload. Ordinary agents should consume the registered compact Markdown, which ignores derived_indexes. Per-block data_summary costs ~150-400 tokens. Full raw cards can be substantially larger and should be loaded only by deterministic query code.

source_role.description: Authoritative source declaration; never inferred from observed constancy.

source_global_id.description: Source-role GLOBprop/GLOBvar/GLOBconstr ID; null only for inline_state.

source_local_key.description: BLKprop_N, BLKvar_N, or BLKconstr_N owner; inline state uses its linked BLKprop_N.

source_instance_key.description: Exact resolved prop_ID/var_id/constr_id, or inline field name.

component_org_num.description: DOIcomp_N that owns a component-linked quantity.

phase_component_org_num.description: DOIcomp_N to which the phase annotation applies; distinct from quantity ownership.

applies_to_occurrence_key.description: Property occurrence linked to inline state; otherwise null.

n_limit_values.description: Censored PropLimit observations, excluded from ordinary numeric statistics.

n_rows.description: Block point-row capacity for property/variable; one declaration row for constraint/inline_state.

n_missing.description: Absent observations after excluding finite, nonfinite, and limit observations.

n_unique.description: Exact number of unique finite parsed values.

coverage_fraction.description: n_values / n_rows, or null when n_rows is zero.

n_applicable_points.description: Finite row-aligned support for property/variable, block rows for a valid constraint, or finite linked-property rows for inline state.

is_varied.description: True exactly when n_unique > 1; never changes source_role.

key_permutations.description: Map from every exact GLOBprop/GLOBvar/GLOBconstr alias to block occurrence_key values. Complete template-equivalent alias families only.

agent_workflow.description: Recommended agent workflow for using PCS INDIV cards
steps: 1. Agent receives query about a property/compound/paper
2. Agent loads PCS ID_and_DK card for the property to understand what it measures
3. Agent finds relevant INDIV card by DOI (one card per paper, same as RMS/CCS/MTDKS)
4. Agent reads registered compact Markdown or blocks_summary.block_index to identify relevant blocks; ordinary agent context omits derived_indexes
5. Deterministic advanced-search code reads blocks_summary.derived_indexes.block_search_adv only after registry narrowing
6. Agent reads data_summary per block (~150-400 tokens) to assess relevance
7. If relevant, agent loads data_points for actual values
8. If method context needed, agent loads MTDKS card via properties[].meas_num_id
9. If purity context needed, agent loads CCS sample card via compounds[].comp_num_id + sample_num
10. If citation context needed, agent loads RMS card via key.doi
